verdict.rationale: Moss documents a public v1 REST API reference in which all actions go through the `/v1/manage` endpoint using an action string (e.g. `createWebSource`). Official SDKs cover Python, JavaScript, Swift, Elixir, C and WASM, with documented index and document CRUD and key management, so agents can drive the product programmatically. The same operations are also exposed through an MCP server, AI SDK tools and a CLI. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404) and independent hands-on corroboration of the REST API.
